review_locator: PMID:9159220, Fibronectin-integrin interactions; PMCID:PMC3039929, Integrin Structure, Activation, and Interactions
primary_title: The novel recognition site in the C-terminal heparin-binding domain of fibronectin by integrin alpha 4 beta 1 receptor on HL-60 cells
decision_basis: The fibronectin-integrin reviews identify the IIICS and heparin-binding regions as alpha4beta1 ligands and cite the primary study mapping a direct alpha4beta1-dependent FN adhesion site.
limitations_preserved: Preserve FN HepII/IIICS peptide and hematopoietic-cell adhesion context; no generic FN affinity or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7765895, Fibronectin and Its Receptors in Hematopoiesis; PMCID:PMC3255974, Structural specializations of alpha4beta7, an integrin that mediates rolling adhesion
primary_title: Alpha 4 beta 7 integrin mediates B cell binding to fibronectin and vascular cell adhesion molecule-1
decision_basis: The hematopoietic fibronectin-receptor reviews identify alpha4beta7 as a fibronectin adhesion receptor and cite primary B-cell/T-cell studies demonstrating FN-coated-surface attachment and antibody-sensitive interaction.
limitations_preserved: Preserve lymphocyte activation state and alpha4beta7 heterodimer context; fibronectin adhesion is distinct from VCAM1/MAdCAM1 binding and no SCI inference is added.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4422796, Tenascin-C and integrins in cancer; PMID:26055518, Tenascin-C: Its functions as an integrin ligand
primary_title: Binding of alpha v beta 1 and alpha v beta 6 integrins to tenascin-C induces epithelial-mesenchymal transition-like change of breast cancer cells
decision_basis: The tenascin-C integrin literature identifies alphaVbeta1 as a TNC-binding integrin and cites the primary study showing divalent-cation-dependent association with TNC-conjugated beads and a cell response.
limitations_preserved: Preserve human breast-cancer, RGD/metal-ion, and integrin-association context; the response is cell-model-specific and does not establish a universal alphaVbeta1 pathway or SCI inference.
